_status: D4: Kansas-local season length from USDA NASS Crop Progress (derived by this script).

profile.name: Winter wheat (Kansas-local season length)

kc_ini.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Winter Wheat - with frozen soils'
kc_ini.region_relevance: Frozen-soil winters assumed (0.7 applies to non-frozen soils)
kc_ini.uncertainty: 0.4-0.7 by winter soil state; wetting frequency also matters

kc_mid.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate; adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 62 at run time

kc_end.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, Winter Wheat, Kc end 0.25-0.4, footnote 10
kc_end.region_relevance: 0.25 = machine harvest (footnote 10: higher value is for hand-harvested crops)

ini.region_relevance: Kansas (ks-field-2); derived from local_calendar once it is filled
ini.uncertainty: PENDING (D4, 2026-11-14): season length from USDA NASS Kansas planting/harvest dates, not yet obtained

dev.region_relevance: Kansas (ks-field-2); derived from local_calendar once it is filled
dev.uncertainty: PENDING (D4, 2026-11-14): season length from USDA NASS Kansas planting/harvest dates, not yet obtained

mid.region_relevance: Kansas (ks-field-2); derived from local_calendar once it is filled
mid.uncertainty: PENDING (D4, 2026-11-14): season length from USDA NASS Kansas planting/harvest dates, not yet obtained

late.region_relevance: Kansas (ks-field-2); derived from local_calendar once it is filled
late.uncertainty: PENDING (D4, 2026-11-14): season length from USDA NASS Kansas planting/harvest dates, not yet obtained

max_root_depth_m.region_relevance: Larger value for modelling soil water stress (Table 22 footnote 1)

depletion_fraction_p.reference: FAO-56 Table 22; daily ETc adjustment p = p_table + 0.04(5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8

ky_season.reference: FAO-56 Chapter 8 Table 24 'Seasonal yield response functions from FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 33' (Doorenbos & Kassam 1979), value 1.05
ky_season.region_relevance: Generic; applied to the whole growing period, water-limited yield only
ky_season.uncertainty: Seasonal Ky only (stage-specific values are not in Table 24); varies with variety and climate

profile.notes: Same FAO-56 Table 12 Kc, root depth, p and height as winter-wheat. Stage lengths are local (D4): NASS Kansas season length split in the FAO-56 Table 11 Idaho proportions 160:75:75:25. Until a cited season length is entered, every strategy using this crop is infeasible.

local_calendar.reference: USDA NASS Crop Progress, Kansas statewide winter wheat 50 % planted -> 50 % harvested (source nass_5f3d5f6af6a82ee7); median of 36 seasons harvested 1984-2019 (range 249-287 d; sowing median 10-03, harvest median 06-26); statewide, not field-level
local_calendar.split_from: FAO-56 Table 11, Winter Wheat, 'Idaho, USA' row (October planting): 160/75/75/25 = 335 days
